about_the_game:
The crown is yours. Will you prove worthy of keeping it? 

You are the last of your kind, the only one who can master Aether, the only one with the right to sit on the throne.

With its long history of conquests, your kingdom is short on allies. To the north, your eternal enemies sit in wait, unseen in their snowy forests. To the south, tribes rebel against your rule. To the west, your only ally refuses to trade in direly needed minerals. And to the east, seas are quiet, but won’t be so for long…

But you won’t face these perils alone. To your side sit your advisors whom you can trust with your very life, and even your very heart.

Your kingdom awaits your decisions. Strengthen your rule by any means necessary, forge new alliances, or watch it all crumble to dust before your eyes.

The choice is yours.

Features

  • Create and customize your character: male, female, straight, gay, bisexual.

  • Set the world state according to your experience in Arcadie: Second-Born.

  • Continue your romance begun in Arcadie: Second-Born.

  • Travel far and wide across your realm and beyond.

  • Immerse yourself in a reactive world and story, with characters that each have with their own motivations and goals.

  • Make decisions that will reshape your kingdom's history for decades to come.

content_descriptors.notes: Arcadie II: Cold Lands is intended for a mature audience. It contains text-based violence, mentions and optional use of alcohol, and text-based optional sexual content.
